correctness.rationale: Two-state stationarity and detailed balance give r_k=m²+(1−m²)ρ^k. Phase enumeration yields eta(2k)=r_k and eta(2k+1)=−(r_k+r_(k+1))/2. Fourier summation splits Bragg masses m² at half-integers and a Poisson-kernel AC density, so diffraction gives |m| and ρ but not sign m. Direct two-phase triple computation gives C012=0 and C013=m(1−m²)(1−ρ)²/2, recovering m and proving minimal distinct-site diameter 3. Admissibility bounds 1−ρ≤2/(1+|m|); optimizing 2s(1−s)/(1+s) gives sharp 6−4√2 at m=±(√2−1), ρ=−(√2−1), included primitive boundary. Independent exact rational Markov path enumeration checked 52 pair/triple identities.
